## Source qualifications

- [Agentflow (v12.0.0+)](https://mermaid.ai/open-source/syntax/agentflow.html): **Warning** Agentflow is in **beta**. The diagram type is selected with the `agentflow-beta` keyword, and the syntax may still change in a backwards-incompatible way before it is declared stable.
- [C4 Diagrams](https://mermaid.ai/open-source/syntax/c4.html): C4 Diagram: This is an experimental diagram for now. The syntax and properties can change in future releases. Proper documentation will be provided when the syntax is stable.
- [Mindmap](https://mermaid.ai/open-source/syntax/mindmap.html): Mindmap: This is an experimental diagram for now. The syntax and properties can change in future releases. The syntax is stable except for the icon integration which is the experimental part.
- [Timeline Diagram](https://mermaid.ai/open-source/syntax/timeline.html): Timeline: This is an experimental diagram for now. The syntax and properties can change in future releases. The syntax is stable except for the icon integration which is the experimental part.
- [Venn diagrams (v11.12.3+)](https://mermaid.ai/open-source/syntax/venn.html): **Warning** This is a new diagram type in Mermaid. Its syntax may evolve in future versions.
